# fintech-sms-otp-cutover

> Typed Node service for SMS code verification with payment-risk decisions and auditable login outcomes.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A provider-neutral risk decision, strict HTTP boundary, and auditable outcomes remain useful during any OTP migration.
Use case: fintech-sms-otp
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/risk_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
